text.brief: A green-card holder from Guangzhou who teaches high school chemistry in Houston tries to close on a starter home in March 2027. The title company refuses and cites the state's new land law.
text.record: Texas enacted a law in 2025 that restricts land purchases by entities and some individuals tied to the People's Republic and three other countries ([Texas Legislature (SB 17)](https://capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/89R/billtext/html/SB00017F.htm)). Florida's 2023 law has faced federal litigation brought by Chinese residents ([Shen v. Commissioner, 11th Cir. No. 23-12737](https://media.ca11.uscourts.gov/opinions/pub/files/202312737.pdf)). The Agriculture Department launched a farm security action plan in July 2025.
text.reading: The Party gains whenever the defenders confuse a person with the Party. Laws that bar individual residents by nationality give the Party a grievance to broadcast and a wedge between Chinese Americans and their own government. This is Stratagem 33, sow discord among the enemy.
text.coreEvent: A federal appeals court rules that a state land law violates equal protection or federal preemption as applied to individual residents from the People's Republic before 2029.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The law aims at the Party and lands on its first victims.
text.fix: Aim land rules at Party control and at sites near military installations. Leave individual residents alone.
